title: Other welfare spending
headline: £24.3bn by 2029-30, including Northern Ireland social security.
description: Change the OBR's 'other spending' welfare line from April 2027, as a percentage of its forecast (£24.3bn in 2029-30). A 1% change is about £0.2bn a year.

baselinePolicy.text: Other welfare spending, which includes Northern Ireland social security expenditure, of £21.0bn in 2025-26 rising to £24.3bn in 2029-30 (Table 4.6).

control.formatLabel: of forecast spending on this line

caveats: Welfare-cap treatment is approximated by line: this whole line is counted inside the cap. The cap excludes the state pension and the payments most sensitive to the economic cycle (jobseeker's allowance and its universal credit equivalent), so a small part of this line is really outside it.
A uniform percentage change to a forecast line is a stylised device standing in for the many policies that could deliver it (rates, uprating, eligibility); no behavioural response is included.

considerations.text: This line includes Northern Ireland social security expenditure, which is a transferred matter: the Northern Ireland Executive, not the Chancellor, sets most of that policy.
